title: Trinity #14 15 16 17 Lot DC Rebirth 2017-2018 Batman Wonder Woman Superman
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Trinity (DC Comics, 2016 DC Universe Rebirth series) starring Batman, Wonder Woman and Superman - 4 consecutive issues. $3.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #14 (Dec 2017) - "Dark Destiny", "Dead Superman!" - Rob Williams, Tony S. Daniel cover
- #15 (Jan 2018) - "Dark Destiny", "Pit of Despair!" - Philip Tan cover
- #16 (Feb 2018) - "Ringing in the New Year with Deadshot" - Guillem March cover
- #17 (Mar 2018) - "No Home for You Here" Part One, "Strangers in a Savage World!" - James Robinson, Patrick Zircher

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
